requirements: All exact FC2A/B/C and PFL3 population rows must be present and count-consistent.
Each FC2 subtype must have exactly one stored FC2->PFL3 direct-prediction block.
All fixed thresholds are reported; no threshold is selected by modeled response or behavior.
Exact source and target body-ID coverage is reported at every threshold.
Instance-column parsing is descriptive only and is allowed to fail without reinterpretation.
interpretation_rules: FC2A/B/C remain separate subtypes; do not pool them because one subtype gives a cleaner topology.
A parsed C-number is an anatomical metadata label only until a literature-derived phase mapping is separately sealed.
No physical angle may be assigned from soma side or C-number by this audit.
No FC2 subtype may be selected or dropped using PFL3 model amplitude, DNa02 turn, or navigation performance.
claim_boundary: This audit can qualify exact MaleCNS FC2A/B/C-to-PFL3 structural support and descriptive instance topology. It cannot qualify goal tuning, preferred goal angles, physiological transmission, comparison computation, steering, or behavior.
